address: Shop H&M, GF, Vang Kei Building, 12 Avenida Da Concõrdia N, Macau, Macau
bio: Though slightly out of the way, Lou Kei is a firm favourite among locals for a simple, good value supper. For over 20 years, its sizeable selection of tasty noodles, congee and Cantonese dishes has won the hearts of countless diners. With heaps of crispy fried garlic and chilli bits, the typhoon shelter-style deep-fried Bombay duck is delicious. Claypot rice with eel in black bean sauce boasts firm, oily fish on crispy scorched rice....
